notes.title: Our new studio release - "Whisker Wanderlust" is now available on the store page
notes.content:
Our studio's healing thick-painted hand-drawn hidden object solo game, "Whisker Wanderlust," has officially announced its store page today~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403446/faed2e618e342ca019c2d727be1a4cd1d3d0b5c7.jpg[/img]

Steam：https://store.steampowered.com/app/3603580/_/

Game Introduction:
✦ Gameplay Features ✦
Main Quest: Advance the main storyline and obtain the game's final ending by collecting yarn balls hidden across environments.
Commissioned Quests: Interact with NPCs within different scenes to unlock side quests and help them gather more items.
Hidden Level: Unlock Postcard Mode by collecting canned food during the main story progression, then gather Cat Collars from treasure chests in this mode to access bonus challenges and uncover hidden storylines! (Psst... exclusive secret narrative included!)
Artistic Discovery: Explore richly textured painterly landscapes filled with classic IP-inspired Easter eggs and visual surprises.
Each level is a whimsical adventure through fantastical storybook worlds. Our signature thick-painted hand-drawn art style makes every frame wallpaper-worthy – a true visual hallmark of the game. Complemented by custom-crafted background music for each environment, this creates an immersive atmosphere that fully draws you into the experience.

notes.title: Notice of Discontinuation for the Stray of Lost Cat Art Book DLC
notes.content:
Dear Users,

Due to the artist's personal request, this DLC will no longer be available for purchase.

For users who have already purchased it:
You can access the DLC files by following this path:
[Location of the Art Collection] → Right-click Soul Fragment of the Stray Cat in your library → Manage → Browse Local Files.

For users who have not purchased it:
You are welcome to take screenshots of your favorite scenes within the game to use as wallpapers!

P.S. Rest assured that the removal of the Artbook DLC will not affect the Stray of Lost Cat game itself or users who have already purchased the DLC (it remains accessible locally as mentioned above).
For any further questions, feel free to leave a comment below or contact our support team via email. We'll reach out to you promptly!

notes.title: Lunar New Year special sale, new all-time lows + new game demos, double the joy！
notes.content:
For this Lunar New Year event, we are excited to present two projects to you: the already launched strategy game "CARD QUEST" and the casual hidden object game "Stray of Lost Cat" which is currently in demo playtesting

♥Upcoming Product: The demo for the first level of the story mode of "Stray of Lost Cat" is now open for playtesting!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403446/2983f7302696a51dcee50b871eded4eb03dc5c66.png[/img]
What could a little cat possibly want to do? All it wants is to enjoy several meals of the new treats its owner has bought! Welcome to "Stray of Lost Cat" where your mission is to save a cat with a peculiar personality. Collect the soul fragments scattered across different scenes, escape from the pursuit of "Meowdis," and embark on a healing leisure journey.
The official release of "Stray of Lost Cat" will meet everyone in 2025. We hope that in the uncertain year ahead, the leisurely and healing "Stray of Lost Cat" can bring you a unique experience. In this vibrant, hand-painted world, a journey to save the cat's soul is about to begin!

♥Currently on Sale: "CARD QUEST" will be on a 30% discount during this Steam Lunar New Year event!
Event Discount Period: January 27, 2025 - February 10, 2025 (Beijing Time)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403446/1b6efa251b964a59bafb991d632d13f46062aec3.png[/img]
"CARD QUEST" is a high-strategy card game themed around cat characters with a gothic style. Here, you will experience thrilling dungeon-style level exploration, strategic use of weapons, equipment, scrolls, and artifacts, defeat mutated cats, save Erin from her nightmare, and embark on an adventure with feline warriors to turn nightmares into dreams.

notes.title: A leisure and healing themed treasure hunting solo trip is about to debut!
notes.content:
The warm sunlight falls on the ground. The little cat slowly opened its eyes and sniffed (inwardly: meowing, the dried fish smells so good)~~; The kitten stood up and stretched lazily, picked up the small fish from the feeder, turned its head and ran away

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403446/099a62a15c67084fe4d0430ec12aff5287ff3fc7.png[/img]

Yo~This is Cat Shiduo Game Studio! Our new game "Stray of lost cat" is about to be released soon. The protagonist of this game is a little cat who is about to lose its legendary ninth life. In order to continue eating the snacks bought by the poop shoveler, the little cat decides to embark on a journey to find its soul.
On this journey, not only do we have to collect scattered soul fragments everywhere, but we also have to evade the pursuit of Meowdis. You will walk through the noisy land of dawn, step into the misty forest, and arrive at the town of Dream Dawn
During this adventurous journey, the kitten will also encounter various people and things to help them complete their assigned tasks Our story will unfold in magnificent scenes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403446/eed3b171c099f14bb03a46bf0bdb2a1552dc84e9.png[/img]

In addition to the tasks in the story mode, we also have a hide and seek mode. Delicious canned cats are the favorite of kittens! Cyber Cat Farming, Start Up~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45403446/7e19a83b3f2bb3820a5100a22740af446ca970b2.jpg[/img]
